bullets: Own the outcome, end to end. Define the roadmap and execution for a member-facing area that spans every care solution, and be accountable for the results it delivers;
Work across everything. Partner with product, design, engineering, clinical, data and growth teams across all solutions to turn many moving parts into one simple, cohesive member…
Build AI-native experiences. Use AI as the foundation, not an add-on, to reinvent how members get care, stay engaged and make progress;
Stay close to members. Run continuous discovery, read real member conversations and feedback, and let evidence, not opinion, drive priorities;
Ship fast and learn faster. Prototype, experiment and iterate quickly, and prove impact with clear metrics such as activation, engagement and retention;
Own the product roadmap from pre-launch through scale, balancing zero-to-one innovation with one-to-100 optimization.
Define and prioritize features that drive member engagement, retention, and clinical outcomes across 4-12 month care journeys.
Establish clear product metrics, success criteria, and feedback loops to rapidly iterate and improve the member experience.
Partner with clinical, regulatory, and compliance teams to ensure product decisions meet healthcare standards while maintaining innovation velocity.
